function.description: Invoke this API to get the LAN Automation session status. Returns all LAN Automation sessions including their discovered devices list, seed device details, IP pools, multicast settings, discovery level, and session creation time. Use this for any query about LAN Automation sessions, LAN Automation discovered devices, or LAN Automation configuration. This is NOT related to the generic Network Discovery feature.
function.name: api_lANAutomationStatus

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

action.description: State (START/STOP) of the LAN Automation session.

ipAddressInUseList.description: List of IP address used by the device.

state.description: State of the device (Added to inventory/Deleted from inventory).

discoveryDevices.description: Specific devices that will be LAN Automated in this session. Any other device discovered via DHCP will be attempted for a reset and reload to bring it back to the PnP agent state at the end of the LAN Automation process before process completion. The maximum supported devices that can be provided for a session is 50.

deviceManagementIPAddress.description: Management IP Address of the device

deviceSiteNameHierarchy.description: Site name hierarchy of the device

isIPAllocated.description: IP Allocation status of the device

isIPAssigned.description: IP Assignment status of the device

discoveryLevel.description: Level below primary seed device upto which the new devices will be LAN Automated by this session, level + seed = tier. Supported range for level is [1-5], default level is 2.

discoveryTimeout.description: Discovery timeout in minutes. Until this time, the stop processing will not be triggered. Any device contacting after the provided discovery timeout will not be processed, and a device reset and reload will be attempted to bring it back to the PnP agent state before process completion. The supported timeout range is in minutes [20-10080].

hostNameFileId.description: File ID for the uploaded file in the nw_orch namespace

hostNamePrefix.description: Hostname prefix of the discovered devices

ipPools.description: The list of IP pools with its name and role.

ipPoolRole.description: Role of the IP pool. Supported roles are: MAIN_POOL and PHYSICAL_LINK_POOL.

multicastEnabled.description: Shows whether underlay multicast is enabled or not.

peerDeviceManagmentIPAddress.description: Peer seed device management IP address.

primaryDeviceInterfaceNames.description: The list of interfaces on primary seed via which the discovered devices are connected.

primaryDeviceManagmentIPAddress.description: Primary seed device management IP address.

redistributeIsisToBgp.description: Shows whether advertise LAN Automation summary route into BGP is enabled or not.

status.description: Status of the LAN Automation session along with the number of discovered devices.
